title: fix: use media wording in user media fetch errors
author: ElliotEtag

gist.summary: The shared media-fetch helper now says “media” rather than “image” in URL, fetch, and size errors, so failed Nova 2 Lite video links no longer produce misleading image wording. This changes message text only: callers, options, and public error codes such as `invalid_image_url` and `image_too_large` remain unchanged. Tests now cover the wording for private video URLs and video hosts returning 404.
